app/src/lib/server/pokeapi.ts:13-56 — API base URL, TTL cache and raw JSON handling isolated in one server-only module

coupling.rationale: Clear server/client seam ('use server' functions, server/ directory, isServer guards in team.ts) and narrow typed interfaces between layers; the only leaks are the ability-specific Card.hidden flag and the team-specific types field on the shared Card type.

abstraction_design.rationale: The presentational abstractions (Section, cards, badges, MoveTable) stretch well, but the per-detail-page scaffold is copy-pasted across routes and the server card builder is half-centralized (cardsFor) with inline duplicates — an Items section would reuse the data helpers fully but copy a route page.

findings.issue: Card/sprite construction duplicated: card() (106-114) is bypassed by homeList (181-187) and teamDetails (336-342)
findings.suggestion: Route all card creation through card() (or a makeCard(id, name, types)) so the Deoxys-class species mapping has exactly one home

findings.issue: typesById building block duplicated verbatim from homeList (154-164)
findings.suggestion: Extract a shared typesByPokemonId() helper used by both homeList and teamDetails

findings.issue: Ability-specific `hidden` flag (and its rendering in PokemonCards.tsx:26-28) is baked into the shared Card type, entangling the generic card component with one feature
findings.suggestion: Pass a per-card note/extra slot from the ability route, or keep the flag but let the caller render it via children/slot

findings.issue: Detail-page scaffold (Title, h1, Switch/Match NotFound, facts dl) is repeated across the five route files; the facts dl is duplicated at pokemon/[name].tsx:117-128
findings.suggestion: Extract a small Facts component (list of dt/dd) and optionally a DetailShell (title, h1, NotFound switch) so new sections like Items don't copy the scaffold

findings.issue: Thead columns are driven by the COLUMNS array but tbody cells are hardcoded, so the column set is defined in two places
findings.suggestion: Render tbody cells from the same COLUMNS definition (cell accessor per column) so adding a column is one edit

findings.issue: Sprite URL pattern `${apiBase()}/media/sprites/pokemon/<id>.png` appears at three sites (114, 185, 341)
findings.suggestion: A frontSprite(id) helper next to apiBase() would make media-path changes (or CDN moves) a one-line edit

summary: A cleanly layered SolidStart app where the API, its URL and cache live in exactly one server module and components consume narrow typed view-models. Editability is held back mainly by intra-module duplication in pokeapi.ts: card/sprite construction and the typesById block each exist in two or three copies, so card-level fixes and a name-sort touch several spots. The presentational abstractions are good, but the per-detail-route scaffold is copied, making Moves-shaped additions (Items) part copy-paste.
